We went to the clinic for a consultation and were told I needed dental treatment. We started searching for a dental clinic, but all the clinics in Phuket were exorbitantly priced, catering exclusively to tourists and trying to squeeze as much money out of you as possible.

I highly recommend this clinic, but you need to make an appointment! You can get there by local transportation or taxi. Thank you so much doctor ♥️🤗🙏
